items.markdown:
Zapier is a subscription-based automation platform . You can sign up or purchase a plan directly through the [Zapier Plans & Pricing Page](https://zapier.com/pricing).[[1]](https://zapier.com/pricing)

#### Zapier Plan Tiers

- **Free** [$0/month]: Includes 100 tasks/month, basic Zaps, Tables, and Forms to get started.
- **Professional** [Starting from $19.99/month]: Unlocks multi-step Zaps, higher task limits, and full platform access.
- **Team** [Starting from $69/month]: Built for collaboration, shared workspaces, and team management.
- **Enterprise** [Custom pricing]: For large-scale organization deployment, advanced security, and dedicated support.[[1]](https://zapier.com/pricing)

*Tip: Opting for yearly billing on paid tiers typically saves around 33% compared to paying month-to-month.* [[1]](https://zapier.com/pricing)

To help you pick the right option, let me know:

- **How many automated tasks** do you estimate needing per month?
- Will you be working **solo** or collaborating with a **team**?
